phase_name: GLP-PILOT-C6 Stage 3 Readiness Certification Contract Independent Verification
summary: Independently verified GPC6C-001 v1.0, the GLP-PILOT-C6 Stage 3 Readiness Certification Contract frozen by Phase 142G. Independently re-derived GPC6C-001's expected content directly from Phase 142F's Architecture, GPC6R-001 and GPC6-001's own text (treated as evidence, never re-decided), and the five framework contracts' own text -- never from Phase 142G's own narrative or conclusions -- then compared that independent derivation against GPC6C-001's actual text. All 200 requirements (GPC6C-REQ-001 through GPC6C-REQ-200) were individually read, citation-spot-checked, and matched to a named source; zero ambiguous requirements were found. Every one of Phase 142F's twenty-two required deliverables is faithfully represented in GPC6C-001 with no redesign, no omitted safeguard, no added authority, and no scope expansion. All 23 required verification activities were performed: independent contract re-derivation; requirement-by-requirement verification; contract identity/scope verification; architectural fidelity verification; certification invariant verification (all twelve invariants, bypass attempts against each, none found); responsibility and role verification (against GPC6-REQ-040, no new role); preconditions verification; certification dimension verification (all fourteen dimensions); evidence contract verification (adversarial forged/substituted/stale/partial/contradictory/unverifiable/out-of-scope/withdrawn evidence tests, all fail closed); procedure verification (skip/reorder/infer-substitute attempts, all blocked); findings and anti-concealment verification (downgrade/split/hide/misclassify/close-without-evidence attempts, all foreclosed); repair boundary verification; verdict model verification (prohibited-combination attempts, all foreclosed); certification record verification; failure/suspension/withdrawal verification; lifecycle separation verification (nine-act chain, implicit-advancement attempts, none found); human-authority boundary verification; GAC-001 Section 9 applicability verification (independently re-read GAC-001 Sections 8-9 and GAC-REQ-034 through GAC-REQ-044, confirmed GPC6C-001 Section 16 correctly freezes applicability as unresolved, neither presumed nor silently resolved, fails closed wherever it would matter, defers binding resolution to proper authority); compatibility verification (against all seven governing documents); security and integrity verification (fourteen adversarial attack vectors, all mitigated); citation and reference verification (every normative citation spot-checked); contract amendment boundary verification; and git/artifact provenance verification (direct git log/git status evidence, not report assertions). Two citation-only, non-normative cross-reference micro-repairs were made directly to GPC6C-001, both disclosed with before/after text: GPC6C-REQ-118's mis-pointing internal reference corrected, and GPC6C-REQ-125's missing internal cross-reference added. One Non-Blocking finding was identified (an inherited citation imprecision at GPC6C-REQ-015/GPC6C-REQ-153 citing PGP-001 Section 3 and PPA-001 Section 3 as authority-assigning sections when both are Terminology sections defining role names; inherited verbatim from GPC6R-001, already independently verified by Phase 142E without this citation being flagged there; disclosed rather than repaired in GPC6C-001 alone, since fixing only this contract's own copy would introduce a new inconsistency across the mirrors chain) plus two Observations (a GAC-001 Section 9 framing-nuance note, and a contract-scale proportionality confirmation); zero Blocking or Deferred findings. Verification verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS. See docs/PHASE_142H_GLP_PILOT_C6_STAGE_3_READINESS_CERTIFICATION_CONTRACT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md and docs/contracts/GLP_PILOT_C6_STAGE3_CERTIFICATION_CONTRACT.md.
